title: On-Adapter-E3: three-member adapter ensemble (fixed initialisations, averaged, no selection)
frozen_at: 2026-10-09, after round 7 (validation re-selected the round-5 configuration; test S = 1.003279) and before any round-8 training
exploratory_disclosure: Exploratory iteration; the seed-2 test period has been used seven times.
test_use_policy: the test streams are evaluated only if the selected candidate is not the round-5 configuration AND its robust validation score is <= 0.985; otherwise no test computation is made for this round

hypothesis.problem: The trained adapter's corrections change sign between periods; part of this may be initialisation/dropout variance of a single adapter.
hypothesis.change: Members m = 0, 1, 2 of the a0e15 training recipe; member 0 is the existing round-3 a0e15 checkpoint, members 1 and 2 reseed torch with 2 + 1000*m immediately before model construction. Ensemble forecast = arithmetic mean of the three members' lr0 forecasts (equivalently the mean adapter residual). Optionally the round-5 backbone-first gate (gs 0.9, mu 0) on top.
hypothesis.falsified_if: validation does not select an ensemble candidate with robust score <= 0.985, or the test S is not below every baseline

selection: seed-2 validation r=0 (entry seed 200 for every member); robust score = max(whole GM, largest per-third GM); argmin; ties toward single+gate
budget: 2 x 36 GPU training cells, 2 x 36 validation trajectories; test trajectories only under the test-use policy
